CHAPTER.CAPTION: A Psalm of David.
CHAPTER.VERS: I will give thanks unto You with my whole heart; before the gods I will make music unto You.
I will bow down toward Your holy temple, and give thanks unto Your name for Your lovingkindness and Your truth; for You have magnified Your Word above all Your name.
In the day when I cried out, You answered me, and made me bold with strength in my soul.
All the kings of the earth shall give thanks unto You, O Jehovah, when they hear the Words of Your mouth.
Yea, they shall sing of the ways of Jehovah, for great is the glory of Jehovah.
Though Jehovah is on high, yet He gives attention to the lowly; but the proud He recognizes from afar.
Though I walk in the midst of distress, You will revive me; You will stretch out Your hand against the wrath of my enemies, and Your right hand will deliver me.
Jehovah will perfect that which concerns me; Your mercy, O Jehovah, is eternal; do not forsake the works of Your hands.
